identityClarification: Exactly TWO functional equipment groups matching source. LEFT: ONE plain short engineering HAMMER, rectangular broad gray iron head with a few wide faceted divisions, straight brown wooden handle angled toward lower-left, little round wooden shaft end protruding on top. No rune or new symbol on hammer. RIGHT: ONE hanging single-wheel wooden PULLEY BLOCK with thick oval/circular brown wood cheeks, dark middle sheave channel, central round axle and a few large fasteners; ONE thick dark iron suspension HOOK at the top with a small open lower-left gap. One thick tan rope runs from the pulley into a neatly folded elongated double loop on the lower-right, with visible open spaces and only a few broad twist segments. Preserve this compact hammer + pulley-and-rope composition. No bridge, tower, scaffolding, extra hammer, extra pulley, worker, nails or additional tools.
